title: The Three Classical Orders
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Mediterranean Travels
description: Interactive infographic overlay comparing the Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders, with hover tooltips, a click-to-open infobox, and a quiz mode.

learningObjectives: Identify the Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian orders from their capitals, bases, flutes, and proportions.
Name a building on the trip route built in each order.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive exploration followed by retrieval practice
keyQuestions: Which part of a column names its order most quickly?
Which features do the Ionic and Corinthian orders share?
commonMisconceptions: Any capital with scrolls is Corinthian; in fact paired volutes mark the Ionic order.
Flutes alone tell the order; Ionic and Corinthian share the same 24-flute pattern.
assessmentOpportunities: Nine-question quiz mode identifying the order from features and buildings

controls.name: Explore
controls.description: Default mode: hover a column for a tooltip, click it for the infobox.

controls.name: Quiz Mode
controls.description: Hides the name pills and asks nine questions answered by clicking a column.
